meta.title: The ticket you cannot afford to skip: inside Spain's Christmas lottery
meta.deck: Every December, millions of Spaniards buy into the same few numbers, hoping for the prize they call El Gordo, the Fat One.
meta.note: 这是一篇仿《经济学人》风格的原创练习文章，不是真实外刊的转载。文中的事实是概括性描述，仅供语言学习，请不要当作引用来源。

sents.en: The ticket you cannot afford to skip: inside Spain's Christmas lottery
sents.zh: 一张不敢不买的彩票：走进西班牙的圣诞彩票
notes: cannot afford to do：承担不起……的后果，这里幽默地说“不敢不买”。
skip：跳过、不参加。
inside ...：深入了解……，标题常用。

sents.en: Every December, millions of Spaniards buy into the same few numbers, hoping for the prize they call El Gordo, the Fat One.
sents.zh: 每年十二月，数百万西班牙人都会合买同样的几个号码，盼着中那个被他们叫作 El Gordo（“胖子”）的头奖。
notes: buy into：入一份（合买），也可比喻“相信、认同”。
hoping for ...：盼望得到……，伴随状语。
El Gordo：西班牙语，字面是“胖子”，指头奖。

sents.en: Few expect to win; what they really fear is being left out.
sents.zh: 没几个人真指望中奖；他们真正怕的，是被落下。
notes: Few expect to win：几乎没人指望中奖，few 表否定。
what they really fear is ...：what 从句作主语，强调句型。
be left out：被排除在外、被落下。

sents.en: The draw, held each year on 22 December, dates back more than two centuries and is broadcast live for hours.
sents.zh: 开奖每年 12 月 22 日举行，历史可以追溯到两百多年前，电视会连续直播好几个小时。
notes: The draw：开奖，名词。held ...：过去分词短语修饰 draw。
date back：追溯到。
is broadcast live：被现场直播，broadcast 的过去分词还是 broadcast。

sents.en: Children from a Madrid school sing out the winning numbers and prizes in a distinctive chant that Spaniards recognise instantly.
sents.zh: 来自马德里一所学校的孩子们，用一种独特的吟唱声唱出中奖号码和奖金，西班牙人一听就能认出来。
notes: sing out：大声唱出来。
in a distinctive chant：用一种独特的吟唱方式。
that Spaniards recognise instantly：定语从句修饰 chant。

sents.en: Full tickets are expensive, so most people buy a fraction of one, known as a décimo, a tenth.
sents.zh: 一整张彩票很贵，所以大多数人只买其中一小份，叫作 décimo，也就是十分之一。
notes: a fraction of：……的一小部分。
known as：被称为。

sents.en: Many go further and split tickets with colleagues, neighbours, the local bar or the football club.
sents.zh: 很多人更进一步，和同事、邻居、街角酒吧或足球俱乐部一起分摊彩票。
notes: go further：更进一步。
split A with B：和 B 分摊 A。

sents.en: This habit of clubbing together is the heart of the tradition.
sents.zh: 这种凑钱合买的习惯，才是这个传统的核心。
notes: club together：大家凑钱（一起买）。
the heart of：……的核心。

sents.en: If an office shares a number and it comes up, half the staff may resign the next morning.
sents.zh: 如果一个办公室合买了一个号码而它中了，第二天早上可能有一半员工辞职。
notes: come up：（号码）被抽中；（问题）出现。
resign：辞职。

sents.en: If it comes up and you did not chip in, you may spend years being reminded of it.
sents.zh: 要是号码中了而你没掏钱，你可能会被人念叨好多年。
notes: chip in：凑一份钱。
spend + 时间 + doing：花……做某事。
be reminded of：被提醒想起。

sents.en: In 2011 the top prize fell on a single village in Aragon, where almost every household had bought a share of the same number.
sents.zh: 2011 年，头奖落在了阿拉贡的一个小村子里，那里几乎家家户户都合买了同一个号码。
notes: fall on：（奖、责任）落在……身上。
household：一户人家。
had bought：过去完成时，在中奖之前就买了。

sents.en: One man, it is said, had not; the cameras found him, cheerful but rueful, among his newly rich neighbours.
sents.zh: 据说只有一个人没买；镜头找到了他，他站在一夜暴富的邻居中间，开朗中带着几分懊悔。
notes: it is said：据说，插入语。
had not = had not bought。
cheerful but rueful：两个形容词作补充说明。

sents.en: The odds of winning the top prize are slim, roughly one in 100,000 per number.
sents.zh: 中头奖的几率很小，每个号码大约十万分之一。
notes: the odds of doing：做成某事的几率。
slim：（机会）微小的。
roughly one in 100,000：大约十万分之一。

sents.en: But the lottery spreads its money widely, paying out thousands of smaller prizes, and even a refund for tickets ending in the same digit as the top prize.
sents.zh: 不过这种彩票把钱分得很散：发放成千上万个小奖，尾号和头奖相同的彩票甚至可以退还本钱。
notes: spread ... widely：广泛分散。
pay out：支付（大笔钱）。
a refund：退款。ending in ...：以……结尾。

sents.en: Economists grumble that it is a tax on hope.
sents.zh: 经济学家抱怨说，这是一种“希望税”。
notes: grumble that ...：嘟囔、抱怨说。
a tax on hope：对希望征的税，讽刺彩票。

sents.en: Yet few Spaniards seem to mind: for many, the ticket is less a bet than a ritual, like a card sent to an old friend.
sents.zh: 可西班牙人似乎并不在意：对很多人来说，这张彩票与其说是赌注，不如说是一种仪式，就像寄给老朋友的一张贺卡。
notes: seem to mind：似乎在意，mind 在这里是“介意”。
less A than B：与其说是 A，不如说是 B。
a card sent to ...：过去分词短语修饰 card。

sents.en: No sooner has the last prize been sung than winners in lucky towns are spraying each other with sparkling wine on national television.
sents.zh: 最后一个奖刚唱完，幸运小镇里的中奖者就已经在全国电视直播中互相喷起起泡酒来了。
notes: No sooner ... than ...：一……就……，No sooner 放句首时要倒装（has the last prize been sung）。
spray A with B：用 B 喷 A。

sents.en: Shops that sold the winning number hang banners boasting of their luck, and the queues outside them grow longer the following year.
sents.zh: 卖出中奖号码的彩票店会挂出横幅炫耀自己的好运，第二年店门外的队伍也会排得更长。
notes: boast of：夸耀、吹嘘。
the following year：第二年。

sents.en: Superstition plays its part, too.
sents.zh: 迷信也起了作用。
notes: play its part：起作用、发挥作用。

sents.en: People travel across the country to buy from outlets with a lucky reputation, and some rub their tickets on a pregnant friend's belly for luck.
sents.zh: 人们跨越大半个国家，去有“幸运”名声的彩票点买票，有的人还会把彩票在怀孕朋友的肚子上蹭一蹭，图个好运。
notes: outlet：销售点、门店。
with a lucky reputation：有好运名声的。
rub A on B：把 A 在 B 上蹭。

sents.en: For all the talk of jackpots, the real prize may be the feeling of being in it together.
sents.zh: 尽管大家嘴上都在谈大奖，真正的奖品也许是“大家一起”的那种感觉。
notes: For all ...：尽管有……。
jackpot：头奖、巨额奖金。
be in it together：同舟共济、一起面对。

sents.en: In a year of rising prices, a shared ticket is a small, cheap promise that nobody will be forgotten.
sents.zh: 在物价上涨的一年里，一张合买的彩票是一个小小的、便宜的承诺：谁也不会被忘记。
notes: In a year of rising prices：在物价上涨的一年里。
a promise that ...：that 从句解释承诺的内容（同位语从句）。

sents.en: Most will lose, of course.
sents.zh: 当然，大多数人都会输。
notes: 短句转折，引出结尾。

sents.en: But they will lose together, and that, Spaniards insist, is half the fun.
sents.zh: 但他们会一起输，而西班牙人坚持说，这正是一半的乐趣所在。
notes: Spaniards insist：插入语，“西班牙人坚称”。
half the fun：一半的乐趣，意思是“乐趣所在”。

vocab.zh: 承担不起（做某事的后果）；买不起
vocab.note: afford 本义是“买得起”。cannot afford to do 还常表示“不能冒险去……”：We cannot afford to wait.（我们等不起。）

ex.en: We [[cannot afford to]] lose this customer.
ex.zh: 我们丢不起这个客户。

ex.en: I [[can't afford to]] take a taxi every day.
ex.zh: 我可没钱天天打车。

vocab.def: to not have enough money to buy something; to be unable to risk something happening

cf.diff: can't afford sth 是“买不起”；can't afford to do 还可以指“承担不起做某事的后果”（We can't afford to wait.）。

ex.en: We [[can't afford to]] lose this customer.
ex.zh: 我们可丢不起这个客户。

vocab.note: skip breakfast（不吃早饭）、skip a class（逃一节课）、skip the ads（跳过广告）。

ex.en: Don't [[skip]] breakfast before an exam.
ex.zh: 考试前别不吃早饭。

ex.en: You can [[skip]] the first chapter.
ex.zh: 第一章可以跳过。

vocab.def: to not do or attend something you usually do; to leave something out

cf.diff: skip 是“故意不做、跳过”（skip breakfast 不吃早饭）；miss 多是“错过”，可能并非故意（miss the bus）。

ex.en: I [[missed]] the last train.
ex.zh: 我没赶上末班车。

vocab.zh: 入股、合买；（比喻）相信、认同
vocab.note: buy into a business（入股生意）。比喻：I don't buy into that idea.（我不信那一套。）

ex.en: Five friends [[bought into]] the same ticket.
ex.zh: 五个朋友合买了同一张彩票。

ex.en: I don't [[buy into]] all that hype.
ex.zh: 我不信那些炒作。

vocab.def: to pay for a share of something; to believe in an idea

vocab.note: leave sb out（把某人排除在外），feel left out（感到被冷落）。

ex.en: Nobody likes to feel [[left out]].
ex.zh: 没人喜欢被冷落的感觉。

ex.en: Don't [[leave out]] any details.
ex.zh: 别漏掉任何细节。

vocab.def: to not be included in a group or activity

vocab.note: date back to + 时间 / date back + 一段时间：The church dates back to 1200.（这座教堂建于 1200 年。）也说 date from。

ex.en: The castle [[dates back]] to the 12th century.
ex.zh: 这座城堡可追溯到 12 世纪。

ex.en: Their friendship [[dates back]] to school.
ex.zh: 他们的友谊从上学时就开始了。

vocab.def: to have existed since a particular time in the past

vocab.note: 过去式和过去分词通常都是 broadcast。broadcast live：直播。上一篇学过名词 broadcaster（电视台）。

ex.en: The match will be [[broadcast]] live.
ex.zh: 比赛会现场直播。

ex.en: The show [[broadcasts]] every Sunday night.
ex.zh: 这档节目每周日晚上播出。

vocab.def: to send out a programme on television or radio

vocab.note: 容易认出来的特点：a distinctive voice / smell / style。名词 distinction。

ex.en: She has a very [[distinctive]] laugh.
ex.zh: 她的笑声很有特点。

ex.en: The building's [[distinctive]] red roof is easy to spot.
ex.zh: 这栋楼独特的红屋顶很好认。

vocab.def: having a quality that makes something easy to recognize and different from others

vocab.note: 名词 / 动词同形：fans chant the team's name（球迷齐声喊队名）。

ex.en: The crowd began to [[chant]] his name.
ex.zh: 人群开始齐声喊他的名字。

ex.en: Monks sang a slow [[chant]].
ex.zh: 僧侣们唱起缓慢的诵经调。

vocab.def: words or a phrase that are repeated many times in a rhythm

vocab.note: a fraction of the cost（成本的一小部分），in a fraction of a second（一瞬间）。数学里的“分数”也是 fraction。

ex.en: It costs a [[fraction]] of the original price.
ex.zh: 价格只是原价的零头。

ex.en: Only a [[fraction]] of the guests stayed late.
ex.zh: 只有少数客人待到很晚。

vocab.def: a small part or amount of something; a number such as ½

vocab.note: 比之前做得更多：Some go further and ...（有些人更进一步……）。

ex.en: Some schools [[go further]] and ban phones completely.
ex.zh: 有些学校更进一步，完全禁止带手机。

ex.en: She [[went further]] and quit her job.
ex.zh: 她更进一步，直接辞了职。

vocab.def: to do more or go to a greater degree than others

vocab.note: split the bill（平摊账单），split into groups（分成小组）。过去式和过去分词都是 split。

ex.en: Let's [[split]] the bill.
ex.zh: 我们 AA 吧。

ex.en: The class [[split]] into three groups.
ex.zh: 全班分成了三组。

vocab.def: to divide something into parts and share it

cf.diff: split 强调“分成几份”（split the bill 平摊账单）；share 强调“共同拥有或使用”。

ex.en: Let's [[split]] the bill.
ex.zh: 我们 AA 吧。

vocab.note: 英式口语：We clubbed together to buy her a present.（我们凑钱给她买了礼物。）

ex.en: We [[clubbed together]] to buy him a bike.
ex.zh: 我们凑钱给他买了辆自行车。

ex.en: The neighbours [[club together]] for a party every summer.
ex.zh: 邻居们每年夏天凑钱办一次聚会。

vocab.def: (of a group of people) to share the cost of something

vocab.note: the heart of the matter（问题的核心），in the heart of the city（在市中心）。

ex.en: Trust is [[the heart of]] any friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何友谊的核心。

ex.en: The hotel is in [[the heart of]] the old town.
ex.zh: 酒店就在老城的中心。

vocab.def: the most central or important part of something

vocab.note: My number came up!（我的号码中了！）也常指话题出现：Your name came up in the meeting.

ex.en: His name [[came up]] in the conversation.
ex.zh: 谈话中提到了他的名字。

ex.en: If anything [[comes up]], call me.
ex.zh: 有什么事就给我打电话。

vocab.def: (of a number) to be chosen in a draw; to be mentioned or to happen

vocab.note: resign from a job / post。名词 resignation（辞职、辞呈）。

ex.en: The minister was forced to [[resign]].
ex.zh: 那位部长被迫辞职。

ex.en: She [[resigned]] to start her own company.
ex.zh: 她辞职去创办自己的公司。

vocab.def: to officially leave your job

cf.diff: quit 是口语的“辞职、不干了”；resign 是正式地递交辞呈。

ex.en: He [[quit]] his job to travel.
ex.zh: 他辞了工作去旅行。

cf.diff: resign 是主动辞职；retire 是到了年龄退休。

ex.en: My dad [[retired]] at sixty.
ex.zh: 我爸爸六十岁退休。

vocab.note: Everyone chipped in £5.（每人凑了 5 英镑。）也可以指插话：chip in with a comment。注意和学过的 chip away at（一点点削弱）区分。

ex.en: We all [[chipped in]] for her birthday present.
ex.zh: 我们大家一起凑钱给她买生日礼物。

ex.en: Can you [[chip in]] a few pounds?
ex.zh: 你能出几英镑吗？

vocab.def: to give a small amount of money towards something along with other people

vocab.note: remind sb of sth：使某人想起……。This song reminds me of my school days.（这首歌让我想起上学的日子。）

ex.en: I'm [[reminded of]] my grandmother whenever I smell roses.
ex.zh: 每次闻到玫瑰香，我就想起奶奶。

ex.en: He doesn't want to be [[reminded of]] his mistake.
ex.zh: 他不想被人提起自己的错误。

vocab.def: to be made to remember something

vocab.note: The prize fell on ...（奖落在……）、The duty fell on me.（责任落到我身上）。日期：Christmas falls on a Friday this year.

ex.en: My birthday [[falls on]] a Sunday this year.
ex.zh: 今年我生日正好是星期天。

ex.en: The job of cooking [[fell on]] me.
ex.zh: 做饭的活落到了我头上。

vocab.def: to be the responsibility of someone; (of a date) to happen on a particular day

vocab.note: household chores（家务），household income（家庭收入）。

ex.en: Almost every [[household]] has a washing machine.
ex.zh: 几乎每户人家都有洗衣机。

ex.en: [[Household]] costs keep rising.
ex.zh: 家庭开支一直在涨。

vocab.def: all the people living together in one house

vocab.note: 常带自嘲的懊悔：a rueful smile（苦笑）。

ex.en: He gave a [[rueful]] smile.
ex.zh: 他苦笑了一下。

ex.en: She looked back on her choice with a [[rueful]] laugh.
ex.zh: 她回顾自己的选择，自嘲地笑了笑。

vocab.def: showing that you are sorry or sad about something, often in a slightly amused way

vocab.note: the odds of winning（赢的几率），against the odds（尽管困难重重）。The odds are that ...（很可能……）。

ex.en: [[The odds of]] that happening are tiny.
ex.zh: 那种事发生的可能性微乎其微。

ex.en: They won against the [[odds]].
ex.zh: 他们在不被看好的情况下赢了。

vocab.def: how likely it is that something will happen

vocab.note: a slim chance（希望渺茫），slim hopes。形容人：苗条的。

ex.en: There's only a [[slim]] chance of rain.
ex.zh: 下雨的可能性很小。

ex.en: Their hopes of winning are [[slim]].
ex.zh: 他们获胜的希望很渺茫。

vocab.def: (of a chance) very small; thin in an attractive way

cf.diff: 说机会小，slim 和 small 都可以；slim chance 更地道。slim 形容人是“苗条”，褒义；thin 只是“瘦”。

ex.en: There's only a [[slim]] chance of rain.
ex.zh: 下雨的可能性很小。

vocab.note: 保险、彩票、赌注的赔付：The insurer paid out millions.（保险公司赔付了数百万。）名词 payout。

ex.en: The insurance company [[paid out]] quickly.
ex.zh: 保险公司很快就赔付了。

ex.en: The game [[pays out]] small prizes often.
ex.zh: 这个游戏经常发小奖。

vocab.def: to pay a large amount of money, for example as a prize

vocab.note: get a refund（拿到退款），a full refund（全额退款）。动词 refund sb（给某人退钱）。

ex.en: I'd like a [[refund]], please.
ex.zh: 我想退款。

ex.en: They [[refunded]] the full price.
ex.zh: 他们全额退了钱。

vocab.def: an amount of money that is given back to you

cf.diff: refund 作名词时重音在前 /ˈriːfʌnd/，作动词时重音在后 /rɪˈfʌnd/。

ex.en: They [[refunded]] my money.
ex.zh: 他们把钱退给我了。

vocab.note: 比 complain 口语，常是小声嘀咕：grumble about the weather。

ex.en: He's always [[grumbling]] about his boss.
ex.zh: 他总在抱怨他的老板。

ex.en: Passengers [[grumbled]] about the delay.
ex.zh: 乘客们抱怨晚点。

vocab.def: to complain about something in a quiet, bad-tempered way

cf.diff: complain 是普通的“抱怨、投诉”；grumble 是小声嘟囔着发牢骚，常常不正式提出。

ex.en: She [[complained]] to the manager.
ex.zh: 她向经理投诉了。

vocab.note: place a bet（下注），a safe bet（稳妥的选择）。口语 You bet!（当然！）

ex.en: He placed a [[bet]] on the horse.
ex.zh: 他在那匹马上下了注。

ex.en: Taking an umbrella is a safe [[bet]].
ex.zh: 带把伞总没错。

vocab.def: an amount of money that you risk on the result of something

vocab.note: 宗教仪式，也指固定习惯：my morning coffee ritual（我每天早上的咖啡仪式）。

ex.en: Tea in the afternoon is a family [[ritual]].
ex.zh: 下午茶是我们家的固定习惯。

ex.en: The wedding followed an ancient [[ritual]].
ex.zh: 婚礼按照古老的仪式进行。

vocab.def: a set of actions that are always done in the same way, often as a tradition

vocab.note: 强调两件事几乎同时发生。No sooner 放句首时后面倒装：No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.（我刚坐下电话就响了。）注意后半句用 than，不用 when。

ex.en: [[No sooner]] had we arrived than it started to rain.
ex.zh: 我们刚到就下起了雨。

ex.en: [[No sooner]] had she left than he called.
ex.zh: 她刚走他就打来了电话。

vocab.conn: No sooner + had / has + 主语 + 过去分词 ... than + 句子
vocab.say: No sooner has the last prize been sung than

pick.q: No sooner ___ home than the power went out.
pick.why: No sooner 放句首要倒装，助动词 had 提到主语 I 前面。

pick.q: No sooner had the film started ___ the baby began to cry.
pick.why: No sooner 固定和 than 搭配；hardly / scarcely 才和 when 搭配。

vocab.note: spray A with B / spray B on A：spray the plants with water（给植物喷水）。名词 a spray（喷雾）。

ex.en: The kids [[sprayed]] each other with water.
ex.zh: 孩子们互相喷水。

ex.en: Farmers [[spray]] the crops in spring.
ex.zh: 农民春天给庄稼喷药。

vocab.def: to cover something with small drops of liquid

vocab.note: 挂在墙上或街上的长条布：a banner reading "Welcome"。网页上的“横幅广告”也叫 banner。

ex.en: Fans held up a huge [[banner]].
ex.zh: 球迷举起了一条巨大的横幅。

ex.en: A [[banner]] across the street announced the festival.
ex.zh: 街上挂着一条横幅宣布节日。

vocab.def: a long piece of cloth with words on it, carried or hung up for people to see

vocab.note: boast of / about sth。也可以表示（地方）拥有值得骄傲的东西：The city boasts two universities.

ex.en: He likes to [[boast about]] his car.
ex.zh: 他喜欢炫耀他的车。

ex.en: The hotel [[boasts of]] a fine view.
ex.zh: 这家酒店以美景自豪。

vocab.def: to talk with too much pride about something you have or have done

cf.diff: boast 多指用嘴“吹嘘”；show off 也可以是拿东西出来“显摆”。

vocab.note: 形容词 superstitious（迷信的）。Breaking a mirror brings bad luck is an old superstition.

ex.en: It's just a [[superstition]].
ex.zh: 那只是迷信。

ex.en: Many sports fans have little [[superstitions]].
ex.zh: 很多球迷都有些小迷信。

vocab.def: a belief that certain objects or actions bring good or bad luck

vocab.note: play a part in sth：在……中起作用。Everyone has to play their part.（每个人都要尽一份力。）

ex.en: Luck [[played its part]], too.
ex.zh: 运气也起了作用。

ex.en: Everyone must [[play their part]].
ex.zh: 每个人都要尽一份力。

vocab.def: to do your share of the work in something

vocab.zh: 销售点、门店；（情绪的）发泄途径
vocab.note: retail outlet（零售店），fast-food outlet（快餐店）。also：an outlet for stress（释放压力的途径）。

ex.en: The chain has 200 [[outlets]] across the country.
ex.zh: 这家连锁店在全国有 200 家门店。

ex.en: Music is my [[outlet]] for stress.
ex.zh: 音乐是我释放压力的方式。

vocab.def: a shop or place that sells a company's products; a way of expressing strong feelings

vocab.note: rub one's eyes（揉眼睛），rub A on B（把 A 在 B 上蹭）。rub it in：揭人伤疤。

ex.en: He [[rubbed]] his tired eyes.
ex.zh: 他揉了揉疲惫的眼睛。

ex.en: [[Rub]] the cream into your skin.
ex.zh: 把乳霜揉进皮肤里。

vocab.def: to move your hand or an object backwards and forwards over a surface while pressing it

vocab.note: For all his money, he isn't happy.（尽管他有钱，却并不快乐。）= despite。

ex.en: [[For all]] its problems, I love this city.
ex.zh: 尽管有种种问题，我还是爱这座城市。

ex.en: [[For all]] her fame, she lives simply.
ex.zh: 尽管很有名，她生活得很简朴。

vocab.def: despite something

cf.diff: for all 很口语，常带“尽管有这么多……（却）”的语气；despite / in spite of 是普通的“尽管”。

ex.en: [[Despite]] the rain, we went out.
ex.zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是出去了。

vocab.note: win / hit the jackpot：中大奖；比喻“交好运、发大财”。

ex.en: She won the [[jackpot]] last week.
ex.zh: 她上周中了头奖。

ex.en: We really hit the [[jackpot]] with this hotel.
ex.zh: 订到这家酒店，我们真是走大运了。

vocab.def: the biggest prize in a lottery or competition

cf.diff: hit the jackpot 也常用来比喻“突然交好运、大获成功”。

ex.en: We really [[hit the jackpot]] with this flat.
ex.zh: 我们租到这套房子真是走大运了。

vocab.note: We're all in it together.（我们是一条船上的人。）

ex.en: Don't worry, we're all [[in it together]].
ex.zh: 别担心，我们是一条船上的。

ex.en: The team felt they were [[in it together]].
ex.zh: 队员们觉得大家是同舟共济的。

vocab.def: to be in the same difficult situation as other people and face it together

vocab.note: Getting lost is half the fun.（迷路正是乐趣所在。）表示过程本身就很有意思。

ex.en: Planning the trip is [[half the fun]].
ex.zh: 计划旅行本身就是乐趣的一半。

ex.en: Getting there is [[half the fun]].
ex.zh: 去的路上就是乐趣所在。

vocab.def: a large part of the enjoyment of something

breakdown.en: No sooner has the last prize been sung than winners in lucky towns are spraying each other with sparkling wine on national television.
points: No sooner ... than ...：“一……就……”，强调两件事几乎同时发生。
No sooner 放在句首，后面倒装：has the last prize been sung（正常语序是 the last prize has been sung）。
than 后面是第二件事：winners ... are spraying each other with sparkling wine。
in lucky towns 修饰 winners；on national television 说明在哪里被看到：全国电视直播。
